sources.role: official standalone source: SDL/Win32 configuration loading, saving and mapping grammar
official project page; v0.60 release, supported OS and GPLv3 evidence

paths.path: pokemini.cfg and pokemini_sdl.cfg beside the emulator executable.
paths.naming: Line-oriented key=value files. pokemini.cfg stores BIOS, EEPROM, state, ROM directory, RTC, audio/video, joystick and keyboard mappings; pokemini_sdl.cfg stores SDL display settings. Command-line options override saved values.

paths.path: pokemini.cfg beside the executable: joyenabled, joyid, joyaxis_dpad, joyhats_dpad, joyplatform, joybutton_menu/a/b/c/up/down/left/right/power/shock, plus primary and alternate keyb_* mappings.
paths.naming: Joystick ID 0-15; button values -1 through 32; keyboard mappings are PokeMini key-table integers. Defaults remain arrows, X/Z/S-or-C, E, A and Esc.
evidence: artifact:readme.txt Keys & Information from v0.60 Linux artifact

paths.naming: EEPROM data is raw `.eep`; -noeepromshare enables per-ROM behavior.
evidence: artifact:readme.txt lines Command-Line -eeprom/-eepromshare from v0.60 Linux artifact

paths.naming: Savestate is explicitly selected by -state; -nostate is default.
evidence: artifact:readme.txt Command-Line -nostate/-state from v0.60 Linux artifact

paths.path: bios.min beside the emulator; -bios <file> overrides; FreeBIOS fallback
paths.naming: Real BIOS is optional; FreeBIOS is used when absent.
evidence: artifact:readme.txt Keys & Information and Command-Line sections from v0.60 Linux artifact

paths.path: No external cryptographic or decryption-key file.
paths.naming: Not applicable; keyboard/controller bindings are configuration, not cryptographic key material.
evidence: source:official PokeMini standalone tree has BIOS, EEPROM and state loaders but no cryptographic-key loader @15cc97f
